old_value: {"id":"vouch-9ogq","title":"git-vouch-gh: registry snapshot from a GitHub org","description":"Mark 2026-10-23: many projects' keyring is 'all the people in GitHub org X'. Separate small tool (metarule 2), post-kernel. Reads org members and their SSH signing keys (GET /users/\u003cu\u003e/ssh_signing_keys; members/teams via the API), maps teams/roles to tiers by an explicit config (e.g. owners -\u003e anchor, a named team -\u003e maintainer, members -\u003e contributor, bot accounts -\u003e automation), and writes the snapshot into a registry tree as person and tier files signed by an org admin's SSH key, one commit per sync so additions/removals are dated in git history. Downstream unchanged: check, export, per-repo registries (vouch-k6mt), patatt/b4. Value over GitHub alone: offline verification with plain git, key validity history that survives key deletion/departure (GitHub's Verified badge does not), reviewable change history. Explicit limits: the forge is that community's trust root (account takeover or careless invite = valid signer); org membership is not endorsement, so gh-sourced registries are marked as such (e.g. a source field or registry-level marker) and never presented as vouched; the kernel registry never reads a forge (decision of 2026-10-23, no forge refs). Fail closed on API errors/partial pagination; never drop members on a failed fetch.","acceptance_criteria":"Against a recorded API fixture (no live network in tests): snapshot produces person/tier files that git vouch check accepts; a member removed in the next sync gets a dated retirement, and their old signatures still verify for the valid window with real git; API error or truncated pagination writes nothing; output marked gh-sourced; tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9.","status":"open","priority":3,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-10-23T17:58:51.935140436Z","created_by":"agent","updated_at":"2026-10-23T17:58:51.935140436Z","dependencies":[{"issue_id":"vouch-9ogq","depends_on_id":"vouch-k6mt","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-10-23T17:58:51.99237313Z","created_by":"agent","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"notes":"Metadata (Mark 2026-10-23: gh can source more for the person file). Record only trust-relevant fields in one namespaced block, e.g. source: {github: {id (numeric user id; key on it, never the login, to stop rename/recycle takeover), created (account creation date), verifiedEmails (org verified-domain emails only), twoFactor (if visible to org owners), sso (SAML identity for enterprise orgs), fetchedAt, api}}. check validates the block's shape but never derives a tier from it. Exclude bio, location, company, blog, avatar, social links: personal data in unerasable git history (GDPR-style deletion), churn, no trust use. Acceptance add: a login renamed/recycled to a different numeric id is treated as a different person."}
